what: A recorded 404 of GET /public/posts/:id or /public/coaches/:handle never settles in a capture: publicGet throws on !res.ok without reading the body, Chrome never reports loadingFinished for the fulfilled JSON body, the request stays in the tool's in-flight set and the page fails 'not-settled' after 20 s (the initial request and both retries stay listed).
how: Either settle() ignores a request whose response headers arrived and whose body nobody reads (responseReceived + no consumer), or publicGet reads/cancels the body before throwing (res.body?.cancel()). usePublic.ts is frozen for this package.
interim: public-post-gone and public-coach-gone are answered by a bodiless 404 fixture (same status as the recording); the page under test is identical.
then: Drop the two inline fixtures and let the recorded 404s answer.
